libs.note: BH-3224. The fast-fail cooldown: a listed runner that failed at once (elapsed <= RUNNER_FASTFAIL_S) with no usage is not ready in bin/agent-call.sh's runner_ready until RUNNER_FASTFAIL_COOLDOWN_S ends, so it is skipped as primary and as tier-2. Half-open: the first call after the window is the reprobe, success clears the mark, another instant failure re-arms it. Per box, in state/runner-fastfail/<runner>. Applied by agent-call.sh through lib_env_apply runner-fastfail. A value that is not a number falls back to the default, never to 0.

knobs.note: Comma or space list of the runners the cooldown watches. grok is the only runner with evidence (about 220 instant rc 1 triage calls in 48h to 2026-09-28); claude has its own account cooldown and rotation. Empty = watch none. Settings key lib.runner-fastfail.runner_fastfail_runners.

A failure that took at most this long, with no tokens reported, is an instant failure and arms the cooldown. A slower failure or one with usage neither arms nor clears it. Settings key lib.runner-fastfail.runner_fastfail_s.

How long a runner that failed instantly is skipped. The first call after it is the reprobe. 0 = off: nothing is marked and every runner is tried as before BH-3224. Settings key lib.runner-fastfail.runner_fastfail_cooldown_s.
